MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 12

2. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 12

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 7

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

12. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
